name: CA-47
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Dave Min holds a D+6 seat with a $3.4M-to-$376K fundraising edge
Prediction markets on Kalshi and Polymarket both price a Democratic win at about 96%
Favorable national environment adds roughly eight points to the Democratic lean
No public polls or expert ratings, keeping uncertainty wider than usual
model.rationale: Fundamentals, a lopsided money advantage, and market pricing all point to a comfortable Min win; with no polls available, uncertainty stays wide but the favorite is clear.
model.watch: A late poll showing a single-digit race or a surge in Republican outside spending would warrant revisiting this outlook.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Dave Min, the Democratic incumbent, defends a Southern California seat with a six-point Democratic lean in a favorable national environment. He has raised $3.4 million to Jenny Le Roux's $376,000 and holds a large cash advantage, with minimal outside spending on either side. Prediction markets on Kalshi and Polymarket both price a Democratic win at about 96 percent.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the outlook rests on fundamentals, money, and market pricing. Those signals consistently favor Min, though the absence of polling keeps uncertainty wider than in well-surveyed districts. Le Roux would need a substantial shift in the environment or an influx of outside support to close the gap. The seat remains a strong Democratic favorite heading into the general election.
